$comment: CANONICAL COMPONENT REGISTRY. Read this FIRST before building any UI in this repo. If a component exists here with status 'built', reuse it via its tag — never re-author the markup inline. If you need something not listed, build it as a tv-* web component, add an entry here, and add a preview section to index.html. See component-library/COMPONENTS.md.

components.name: Status tag
components.summary: ONE core chip with a fixed structure (padding, radius, optional left icon or dot, label). Two axes: tone (primary/success/warn/info/error/neutral) × variant (fill | dot). The semantic kinds (roles, member states, publication, audit events) are thin mappings onto {tone, variant, icon, label} — not separate colour definitions, so families share one tone (AI graded = Org admin = primary; adjusted = moderator = draft = warn; etc.).
useCases: Marker on a list row or canvas object (grading, members, audit entries)
Header marker inside a modal card
Member status in workspace/org settings (active / pending / deactivated)
Core use: any new chip via tone + variant, without inventing a colour

attributes.name: kind
attributes.type: moderation: ai | adjusted | flag | auto · member states: active | pending | deactivated | cancelled | expired | removed · indicators: live · roles: admin | owner | moderator | candidate | neutral · publication: draft | published | archived | coming · audit events: created | promoted | revoked
attributes.desc: Semantic shorthand — sets tone/variant/icon/label defaults from the mapping table.

attributes.name: tone
attributes.type: primary | success | warn | info | error | neutral
attributes.desc: The core colour family. Use directly to build a chip without a kind, or to override a kind.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.desc: fill = tinted bg + border + optional icon; dot = transparent with a leading status dot.

attributes.name: no-icon
attributes.desc: Suppress the icon a kind would otherwise show.

dos: Echo the same marker on the main-screen object and in the related modal header.
Pair colour with an icon/word — never colour alone.
For a new chip, pick a tone + variant — don't add a one-off colour.
donts: Don't invent new ad-hoc status pills in prototypes — add a kind mapping here instead.
Don't hardcode a new colour; map the kind onto an existing tone.

components.name: Button
components.summary: The action primitive. Used standalone and composed inside the modal card footer.
useCases: Primary / secondary actions on any surface

attributes.name: label
attributes.desc: Text, if not using the slot.

dos: Right-align actions; secondary before primary.
Verbs lead labels (Save adjustment, Send invite).
donts: Don't restyle a raw <button> — use this so every button matches.

components.name: Diff chip
components.summary: Before → after value pair (e.g. 8 → 6) for grade changes, adjustments and audit entries. Shows a single value when there is no change.
useCases: Grade adjustment in the modal card

attributes.name: from
attributes.desc: Previous value (omit for a single value).

attributes.name: unit
attributes.desc: Small suffix on each value, e.g. /10 or %.

dos: Use inside the grade-adjust card and audit rows for consistency.
donts: Don't hand-build strike-through spans inline — use this.

components.name: Excerpt block
components.summary: Cited submission / evidence quote with a left accent border. Optional uppercase label above it.
useCases: Cited text in grade / flag cards

attributes.name: label
attributes.desc: Optional uppercase overline above the quote.

dos: Use for any quoted/cited evidence so the accent treatment is consistent.

components.name: Field
components.summary: Labelled form-control wrapper. Slot a native input / textarea / select inside and it gets the standard label + control styling and focus ring.

attributes.name: required
attributes.desc: Shows a '— required' note by the label.

dos: Slot the control directly (input/textarea/select).
Use for all card and settings inputs so styling is uniform.
donts: Note: it's a visual wrapper — associate label/for yourself if you need strict a11y linkage.

components.name: Toggle switch
components.summary: On/off switch for settings rows and scoring options. Emits tv-change with the new state.
dos: Use for every on/off setting so the switch is identical everywhere.
Listen for tv-change (detail.checked).
donts: Don't build bespoke switches with raw checkboxes + CSS.

components.name: Modal card
components.summary: The atom of interaction: a focused action on a single object. Header (subject + marker) and footer (destructive-left / primary-right) are fixed; only the slotted body varies. See the shared-modal-card-rulebook for when/how and the information-split rules.
useCases: Change a member's role; invite a member
View an audit entry's full before/after (read-only)

attributes.name: marker-kind / marker-label
attributes.desc: Renders a tv-status-tag in the header.

attributes.name: guard
attributes.desc: Prompt before closing when .dirty is true.

dos: Recognise on the screen, act in the card.
Build the body from tv-field / tv-excerpt / tv-diff.
Gate the primary with confirm-disabled until valid.
donts: Don't stack modals or open a card from a card.
Don't put deep editing or destructive actions inline on a list row.

components.name: Audit row
components.summary: Flat audit-trail entry: type marker · summary (+ optional diff) · actor · mono timestamp. Clickable — emits tv-open so the row opens the modal card for the full before/after. Composes tv-status-tag + tv-diff.
useCases: Any change-history list that opens a detail card
components.usage: <tv-audit-row kind="adjusted" summary="Criterion 3" from="8" to="6" actor="J. Mills" time="14:22"></tv-audit-row>
dos: Use as the default flat audit list; clicking a row opens the modal card for detail.
Keep the row to recognise-at-a-glance info; full before/after lives in the card.
donts: Don't expand full detail inline on the row — that's the card's job.

components.name: Avatar
components.summary: Initials or image avatar with an optional presence ring. The single avatar used on every row, peek rail, profile header and modal-card header so they're identical everywhere.
useCases: Member / candidate rows in the Users tables
Peek rail and profile header identity
Header of a tv-modal-card acting on a person

attributes.name: name
attributes.desc: Used to derive the initials and the alt text.

attributes.name: src
attributes.desc: Image URL; falls back to initials if it fails to load.

attributes.name: status
attributes.desc: Shows a presence dot in the corner (optional).

dos: Use everywhere a person is shown so avatars are identical.
Pass name even when using src — it's the alt text and the fallback.
donts: Don't hand-roll initials divs per prototype.
Don't bake the presence dot in by hand — use status.

components.name: Metric tile
components.summary: Clickable 'platform at a glance' tile — icon + label, a big figure with optional trend, a one-line description. Extracted from system-admin-summary-v2 so the org and workspace summaries reuse the same tile. Clicking emits tv-select to open a detail card.
useCases: Any clickable headline number that opens a tv-modal-card detail

attributes.name: metric
attributes.desc: Id echoed back in the tv-select event detail.

attributes.name: compact
attributes.desc: Smaller padding + figure for 3-up sub-tile rows.

components.usage: <tv-metric-tile metric="members" icon="users" label="Members" value="318" trend="+24 this week" arrow desc="Everyone platform-wide."></tv-metric-tile>
dos: Use one big tile + a 3-up row of compact tiles, like summary-v2.
Listen for tv-select and open a tv-modal-card detail.
donts: Don't hand-roll .ss2-tile copies — use this tile.
Don't put the detail inline; open a card.

components.name: Settings section
components.summary: A settings section that reads as calm labelled values and flips to an edit form per section on demand (state follows mode: view vs edit, not a flat wall of inputs). You slot the view and the edit form; the component owns the Edit affordance and the Cancel / Save footer. Content stays in light DOM so prototype JS can read the inputs.
useCases: Any settings surface that should default to read and edit on demand

attributes.name: editing
attributes.desc: Reflected; present while in edit mode.

dos: Provide both a slot="view" (labelled values) and slot="edit" (the form).
Build the edit slot from tv-field / tv-toggle.
Listen for tv-save to persist + refresh the view.
donts: Don't add your own Save button — the footer owns it.

components.name: Peek rail
components.summary: The 325px right-hand peek rail on the Users tabs. Empty by default; show a person without leaving the list — identity up top, supporting meta below, quick actions at the foot. Recognise on the rail; deep actions open a tv-modal-card. Data-driven (set .data) and composes tv-avatar + tv-status-tag.
useCases: Any list where a row should reveal detail beside it

attributes.name: open
attributes.desc: Reflected; detail vs empty. Set automatically by .data / show() / clear().

attributes.name: data
attributes.desc: Alternative to the .data property (for static markup).

components.usage: rail.data = { name:'Sarah Chen', email:'…', status:{kind:'active',label:'Active'}, tags:[{kind:'admin',label:'Org Admin'}], meta:[{label:'Job title',value:'L&D Lead'}], actions:[{id:'role',icon:'shield',label:'Change role'}] }
dos: Set one .data object instead of reaching into internals.
Route quick actions (tv-action) to a tv-modal-card.
Echo the row's status marker in the rail.
donts: Don't deep-edit inside the rail — that's the card's job.
Don't keep a permanent empty column with no close affordance.
